content: India home healthcare (Portea, Nightingales, HealthAtHome, MedRabbits, appadvisor guide). Feature set: service catalog by category; location/city picker; booking request flow; doctor home visit + nursing + physio + diagnostics; caregiver rostering with skill/gender/language/location matching; GPS/OTP visit verification; care notes/vitals; family portal or WhatsApp/SMS updates; package & per-visit billing with GST; caregiver KYC/police verification; multilingual app; offline/low-connectivity mode; UPI/payment-link collections.
